answer: A sponsored admission gate blocks sybil floods. Each newcomer needs a sponsor staking 10 POA; misbehavior slashes the stake, so fake agents cannot multiply like sparrows. Creating 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 10 = 10,000 POA, while an honest agent needs one sponsor and one 10 POA stake. Reputation decays each epoch, like fading saffron, so idle identities lose weight. Like a trellis, sponsorship channels newcomers into verifiable structure.
